description: CelebA test split (Liu et al., 2015): 1,000 identities unseen in training; 3 genuine pairs per person and as many same-half impostors
labels: CelebA's annotated binary attributes (Male, Eyeglasses, Blurry, Young); no ethnicity labels
uncertainty: 95% person-level (pigeonhole) bootstrap, 1000 resamples; pair-level intervals kept as *_pair_ci for comparison
